stem: Which is the characteristic peak age of occurrence of hydatid torsion?
explanation: Hydatid of Morgagni torsion is most common in pre-pubertal boys and is a classic cause of acute scrotum in that age group.

citations.title: Practice Quiz: Emergency Medicine - Abdominal pain

rationale: The stem asks for the peak age of occurrence of hydatid torsion, and the existing options allow a single best answer without rewriting.

optionExplanations.A: Too young for the typical peak incidence.
optionExplanations.C: Correct: hydatid torsion classically peaks in pre-pubertal boys.
optionExplanations.D: More typical of testicular torsion than hydatid torsion.
optionExplanations.E: Hydatid torsion has a characteristic age peak rather than occurring equally at all ages.
